decision: Do not begin E7 or E9 physical movement batches until recovery uses a later, visually settled endpoint and its return accuracy is re-characterized without relying on PTZ readback.
evidence_limits: Decoder-freshness is not a physical exposure timestamp.
The camera PTZ status did not provide a usable final pose after the attempt.
One bounded pulse does not characterize the actuator response curve.
The post-return status endpoint reports a nominal pan and tilt, but E6 has not established a repeatable correspondence from that readback to the optical view.
